integrity: The exact series and inequalities are proved analytically. A standalone numerical checker supplies limited finite diagnostic checks, not a proof of an infinite-dimensional statement.
scientific_limitations: Standard Euclidean Brownian path, unit target, integer dimensions; result concerns logarithmic mean, not finite raw mean or full stochastic ordering; published Mellin transform is an essential input; priority beyond inspected sources is not certified.
title: Strict dimensional convexity of logarithmic Brownian-hull absorption time
